Name: Rigid Marching Formation
Description: Maintains a centered row-major marching grid behind a freely controlled leader using a rate-limited rigid formation frame.
Source:
-- A leader-relative marching grid backed by the native rigid-formation
-- controller. The launch roster is frozen, the leader is excluded, followers
-- fill rows from leader-left to leader-right, and excess followers stand down.

local participants = mop.participants.list()
local local_slot = mop.get_slot()
if #participants ~= mop.get_count() then
    error("Marching Formation participant snapshot does not match the launch roster")
end

local function text(value)
    if value == nil then return "" end
    return tostring(value)
end

local function base_name(value)
    value = string.lower(text(value)):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    local separator = string.find(value, "@", 1, true)
    return separator and value:sub(1, separator - 1):gsub("%s+$", "") or value
end

local function same_character(left, right)
    local left_base = base_name(left)
    local right_base = base_name(right)
    return left_base ~= "" and left_base == right_base
end

local launch_anchor = text(mop.get_var("anchor"))
if launch_anchor == "" then launch_anchor = text(mop.get_run_target()) end
if launch_anchor == "" then launch_anchor = text(mop.get_var("mop_origin")) end
if launch_anchor == "" and participants[1] then launch_anchor = text(participants[1].name) end
if launch_anchor == "" then error("Marching Formation could not resolve a leader") end

local function current_anchor()
    local value = text(mop.get_var("anchor"))
    if value == "" then value = launch_anchor end
    return value
end

local function integer_variable(name, fallback)
    local value = mop.get_number(name, fallback)
    local rounded = math.floor(value + 0.000001)
    if math.abs(value - rounded) > 0.0001 or rounded < 1 or rounded > 32 then
        error(name .. " must be an integer from 1 through 32")
    end
    return rounded
end

local function distance_variable(name, fallback)
    local value = mop.get_number(name, fallback)
    if value < 0.10 or value > 20.0 then
        error(name .. " must be between 0.10 and 20.0 yalms")
    end
    return value
end

local function bounded_variable(name, fallback, minimum, maximum)
    local value = mop.get_number(name, fallback)
    if value < minimum or value > maximum then
        error(string.format("%s must be between %.2f and %.2f", name, minimum, maximum))
    end
    return value
end

local function boolean_variable(name, fallback)
    local value = mop.get_var(name)
    if value == nil or text(value) == "" then return fallback end
    value = string.lower(text(value))
    if value == "true" or value == "yes" or value == "on" or value == "1" then return true end
    if value == "false" or value == "no" or value == "off" or value == "0" then return false end
    error(name .. " must be true or false")
end

local function slot_offset(index, columns, horizontal, vertical)
    local zero = index - 1
    local row = math.floor(zero / columns) + 1
    local column = zero % columns
    local x = (column - (columns - 1) / 2) * horizontal
    local z = -row * vertical
    return x, z, row, column
end

local function add_neighbor(neighbors, followers, index, active_count, columns, horizontal, vertical)
    if index < 1 or index > active_count then return end
    local x, z = slot_offset(index, columns, horizontal, vertical)
    neighbors[#neighbors + 1] = {
        name = followers[index].name,
        offset_x = x,
        offset_y = 0,
        offset_z = z,
    }
end

local last_signature = nil
local standing_down = false
local leading = false
while mop.is_running() do
    local anchor = current_anchor()
    local followers = {}
    local local_follower_index = nil
    local local_is_leader = false
    for _, participant in ipairs(participants) do
        if same_character(anchor, participant.name) then
            if participant.slot == local_slot then local_is_leader = true end
        else
            followers[#followers + 1] = participant
            if participant.slot == local_slot then local_follower_index = #followers end
        end
    end

    local rows = integer_variable("rows", 4)
    local columns = integer_variable("columns", 8)
    local horizontal = distance_variable("horizontal", 1.0)
    local vertical = distance_variable("vertical", 1.5)
    local precision = bounded_variable("precision", 0.12, 0.02, 1.0)
    local neighbor_correction = bounded_variable("neighbor_correction", 0.25, 0.0, 0.5)
    local maximum_neighbor_correction = bounded_variable(
        "maximum_neighbor_correction", 0.35, 0.0, 2.0)
    local preserve_emote = boolean_variable("preserve_emote", false)
    local capacity = rows * columns
    local active_count = math.min(#followers, capacity)

    local signature = table.concat({
        base_name(anchor),
        local_follower_index or 0,
        #followers,
        rows, columns,
        string.format("%.4f", horizontal),
        string.format("%.4f", vertical),
        string.format("%.4f", precision),
        string.format("%.4f", neighbor_correction),
        string.format("%.4f", maximum_neighbor_correction),
        tostring(preserve_emote),
    }, ":")

    if local_is_leader then
        if not leading then
            mop.actions.stop_movement("local")
            mop.log("Marching Formation: this character is now the leader and remains under operator control")
            leading = true
            standing_down = false
            last_signature = nil
        end
    elseif local_follower_index == nil then
        if not standing_down or signature ~= last_signature then
            mop.actions.stop_movement("local")
            mop.log("Marching Formation: local character is not in the frozen follower roster")
            standing_down = true
            leading = false
            last_signature = signature
        end
    elseif local_follower_index > active_count then
        if not standing_down then
            mop.actions.stop_movement("local")
            mop.log(string.format(
                "Marching Formation: standing down; slot %d exceeds live capacity %d",
                local_follower_index, capacity))
            standing_down = true
        end
        leading = false
        last_signature = signature
    elseif signature ~= last_signature or standing_down or leading then
        local offset_x, offset_z, row, column = slot_offset(
            local_follower_index, columns, horizontal, vertical)
        local formation_radius = 0
        for index = 1, active_count do
            local x, z = slot_offset(index, columns, horizontal, vertical)
            formation_radius = math.max(formation_radius, math.sqrt(x * x + z * z))
        end
        if formation_radius > 100 then
            error(string.format(
                "Marching Formation radius %.2f exceeds the native 100-yalm limit",
                formation_radius))
        end

        local neighbors = {}
        if column > 0 then
            add_neighbor(neighbors, followers, local_follower_index - 1, active_count, columns, horizontal, vertical)
        end
        if column + 1 < columns then
            add_neighbor(neighbors, followers, local_follower_index + 1, active_count, columns, horizontal, vertical)
        end
        if row > 1 then
            add_neighbor(neighbors, followers, local_follower_index - columns, active_count, columns, horizontal, vertical)
        end
        add_neighbor(neighbors, followers, local_follower_index + columns, active_count, columns, horizontal, vertical)

        mop.follow_actor {
            anchors = { anchor },
            offset_x = offset_x,
            offset_y = 0,
            offset_z = offset_z,
            face_anchor = true,
            facing_offset = 0,
            precision = precision,
            brake_at_position = true,
            pursuit_prediction = false,
            immediate_steering = true,
            rigid_formation = true,
            formation_radius = formation_radius,
            neighbors = neighbors,
            neighbor_correction = neighbor_correction,
            maximum_neighbor_correction = maximum_neighbor_correction,
            mirror_walk_run = true,
            mirror_sprint = true,
            preserve_emote = preserve_emote,
        }
        mop.log(string.format(
            "Marching Formation: follower %d/%d, row %d, column %d, leader %s",
            local_follower_index, active_count, row, column + 1, anchor))
        standing_down = false
        leading = false
        last_signature = signature
    end

    mop.wait(0.10)
end
